title: Billing office rule for claims and remittances on the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
Every refill shipped on a payer tier of the Urology and Continence Supply Program is billed to the payer named on the program's coverage record. It is billed by one original claim per shipment, with the ship date as the date of service. The Continence Self-Pay Program files no claims.

## Timely filing

An original claim must be transmitted no later than the tier's timely-filing limit, in calendar days after the date of service of the shipment it bills. The count runs in calendar days from that ship date, and the last day is allowed. A shipment whose filing limit has passed is billed to neither the payer nor the customer. Larkfield writes it off.

| Hypothetical: 180-day limit, ship date day 0 | Outcome |
|---|---|
| transmitted on day 180 | timely: the last day is allowed |
| not transmitted by day 180 | filing limit passed: written off by Larkfield, billed to no one |

## Corrected and void claims

A corrected claim replaces an original claim when the units, item or dates billed were wrong, or when some of the units were returned. A void claim withdraws an original claim when all of its units were returned. Both reference the same shipment as the original.

## Remittance and patient responsibility

When a remittance posts, the patient responsibility added to the customer's balance is the allowed amount less the amount the payer paid. The remittance itemizes it as deductible, coinsurance and copay. Larkfield never posts more than that. On a payer tier, Larkfield never bills the customer the difference between its billed charge and the allowed amount.

*Hypothetical remittance:* billed charge 120.00 USD, allowed amount 80.00 USD, payer paid 64.00 USD. The patient responsibility posted is 80.00 USD less 64.00 USD, which is 16.00 USD. The 40.00 USD between the billed charge and the allowed amount is never billed to the customer.

## Secondary coverage

- On tiers where crossover to secondary applies and the customer has an in-effect secondary coverage record, the patient responsibility is crossed over to the secondary payer. The secondary payer's payment is posted as a secondary-payer balance adjustment against that remittance before any amount is statemented.
- On other tiers, Larkfield's billing team bills a secondary coverage only after the primary remittance posts.

## Medicaid

On the Continence Medicaid Program, a customer is never billed for a Medicaid-covered item beyond the patient responsibility the Medicaid remittance shows.
